payload.headline: Invoice created and sent but one check failed; multiple avoidable errors inflated call count
what_went_wrong: Used wrong endpoint casing 'POST /order/orderLine' (capital L) instead of '/order/orderline', causing an unknown endpoint error and extra search call.
Check 4 failed (likely VAT type or customer lookup issue) — the agent used vatType id=6 without verifying it corresponds to 'no VAT' (0%) for the invoice line.
Tried 'GET /company' and 'GET /company/{id}' literally before discovering the correct pattern via whoAmI, adding 3 wasted 4xx calls.
Customer was created fresh instead of searching for existing Bergwerk GmbH (org 868341580), risking duplicate and potentially causing the failed check.
what_worked: Successfully resolved the bank account requirement by updating ledger account 1920 with a bank account number.
Invoice was ultimately created and sent via PUT /invoice/{id}/:send.
what_to_try_next: Search for existing customer by organizationNumber before creating a new one: GET /customer?organizationNumber=868341580 to avoid duplicates and potential scoring failures.
Verify the correct VAT type for 'no VAT' (0%) by inspecting /ledger/vatType results before using id=6; the failed Check 4 likely relates to wrong VAT type on the order line.
Learn the correct endpoint casing (/order/orderline lowercase) and use GET /token/session/>whoAmI early to get company ID, eliminating the 3 wasted company-lookup calls.
unnecessary_calls: GET /company/{id} — literal placeholder used, caused 422 error; should have used whoAmI first
GET /company/1 — blind guessing company ID, caused 404; whoAmI was the right approach
GET /company/107820037 (second call) — company was already fetched once, duplicate call
